summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of the disposition of its 100% equity interest in Juxing Investment Group (Hong Kong) Limited to Shengshi International Group Inc. The aggregate purchase price is US$2,000,000, payable in installments over three years post-closing. The sale includes all subsidiaries and VIE-controlled entities. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing confirms the closing on June 25, 2026. This is a non-US filing; Form 6-K is the foreign private issuer equivalent of a current report. Watch for installment payment defaults or adjustments that could affect valuation.
